DB.description: D1 database used to store encrypted private notes and auth rate-limit records.

APP_PASSWORD.description: Strong password for new default vaults. During a legacy upgrade, keep the existing value through the first post-upgrade login so its encryption key-check can be initialized; retain that old vault passphrase until all notes are re-encrypted.

COOKIE_SECRET.description: Optional advanced override for session/share signing. If omitted, the Worker atomically creates a unique 256-bit signing secret in its D1 database.

APP_PASSWORDS.description: Optional additional isolated vaults. Format: vault_id=password,guest=another-password.

APP_NAME.description: Public application brand name shown in the browser and share page. Default: `Private Notes`.

APP_SHORT_NAME.description: Public short title shown in the app and when installed as a PWA. Default: `我的笔记`.

APP_DESCRIPTION.description: Public application description used in page metadata and the PWA manifest.
